purpose: Teach: 教頭/推し進め/確証/製本/スキャナ/試験場/防火/配色

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、地元教頭先生にもご相談された
lines.en: When you were founding the company, you consulted with the local school principal, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Quiet affection in the voice — speaking about the father's memory with tender respect. Slow, reflective pace. No rush to the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員と共に事業を推し進めた
lines.en: Yes. My father pushed the business forward alongside his employees.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost formal. A slight pause before speaking, as if gathering the weight of memory. Steady, honest delivery. Sincere without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、確証のない投資はされなかったぞ
lines.en: Your father never made investments without certainty, did he.
lines.style: Warm tone underneath, but carrying a note of quiet insistence — almost protecting the father's memory. Slow, deliberate. A man speaking what he knows to be true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社史を製本する作業を自ら確認された
lines.en: Yes. My father personally verified every step of binding the company history.
lines.style: Steady, clear voice. The words come carefully — each one grounded in specific memory. Slight weight on the personal attention the father gave. Humble, not boastful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新しいスキャナ技術にも興味をお持ちだった
lines.en: Your father was interested in the new scanning technology too, wasn't he.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone. A slight smile in the voice — remembering something endearing about the father's curiosity. Gentle pace. Trailing off slightly, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは資格の試験場まで自ら足を運ばれた
lines.en: Yes. My father personally attended the certification exam venue.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the delivery. Not boasting — simply stating the father's dedication. Slow, grounded. A man speaking what he witnessed firsthand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、防火対策を徹底するご指示をされたぞ
lines.en: Your father gave strict orders on fire prevention, didn't he.
lines.style: Firmness tempered with respect. A note of emphasis on the father's decisiveness. Not harsh — more like confirming something important that matters still. Deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはロゴの配色にこだわった
lines.en: Yes. My father was exacting about the company logo's color scheme.
lines.style: Warm, almost gentle close. A man who has moved through memory to a final, tender detail. Slight softness at the end — a small smile in the voice. Wise, contained.
